name: compose-bridge
description: Deterministic AST-guided mutations for Jetpack Compose. Allows AI agents to safely edit UI tokens (colors, dimensions) with dry-run and git-style diffs.
author: JALAL591

tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: Scans the project and lists all registered design tokens and hardcoded values.

tools.name: set_token
tools.description: Mutates a specific token value via AST byte-offset.

tools.name: add_token
tools.description: Extracts a hardcoded value into a new design token.

tools.name: rollback_last
tools.description: Reverts the last mutation safely using the local journal.

tools.name: get_token_impact
tools.description: Shows all Composables affected by changing a specific token.

tools.name: suggest_token_split
tools.description: Suggests splitting a token if it's used in semantically different contexts.
